title: DripStoneDamage
description: Set the max damage for falling dripstones
body:
# DripStoneDamage
Required Plugin: https://modrinth.com/plugin/kotlinplugins
- Allows to set the maximum damage dealt by falling dripstones.
- Usage: ```/dripstone <value>``` ( there's also config.yml, you can change value in it, no reload required ) 
- Required permission to use this command: ```dripstonedamage.admin```
- Players with op (/op nickname) have this required permission by default.   
- The purpose of this plugin is to get some control under this powerful weapon.  
- Check out other plugins: https://modrinth.com/user/Winlyps
